title: Account handover: QBR + renewals quick-hit list
content:
Quick scratchpad for transfers / daily follow-ups (notes to self).

2026-03-18 MORNING CONTEXT:
- Backfill for Lina today; I'm stepping into her accounts for the week. Keep everything tight and document decisions.
- Goal: triage renewal risk + finish QBR prep for 3 accounts.

TODAY (top 6):
- [ ] BrightBox Health: finalize QBR deck + data asks (due EOD)
- [ ] AtlasFin: confirm renewal pricing cadence + draft upsell play (call 3/26)
- [ ] EduScale: escalate latency bug and confirm ETA from infra
- [ ] Sync with Solutions Eng (Aisha) re: demo VM snapshot for BrightBox
- [ ] Update renewal tracker spreadsheet row + ping finance for PO status
- [ ] Send one-line status to Lina + attach handover notes

Per-account notes:
1) BrightBox Health (QBR 2026-04-02) - risk: medium
   - Current usage trend: +18% tokens MoM, sustained during batch inference jobs.
   - Open items: latency regression on nightly batch (ticket CS-2123), need kernel/quantization notes from infra.
   - Asks for QBR: 2 slides: 1) performance/cost trend with recommendation (enable prefix caching); 2) product roadmap alignment (vector-store roadmap).
   - Action: request demo VM (Aisha) + run quick perf sample by Fri 3/19.
   - Talking points: show 10% cost savings scenario by enabling automatic batching + 5% latency improvement with model variant v2-q8.
   - Stakeholders: Maya (PO), Greg (infra), Lina (was lead).

2) AtlasFin (renewal target 2026-05-06) - risk: high (negotiations ongoing)
   - Renewal counterparty: Camille (Procurement). Waiting on official renewal PO.
   - Finance ask: confirm committed GPUs and overage rates before sending renewal quote.
   - Upsell opportunity: Dedicated capacity for compliance-sensitive workloads (pitching reserved 2x nodes).
   - Notes: had pricing pushback on pre-emption vs dedicated. Need to have fallback cost table.
   - Action: Draft two-tier renewal options (standard + reserved); send preliminary quote by 3/20. CC: Luca.

3) EduScale (support follow-up) - risk: low but visibility needed
   - Issue: interactive prompt latency intermittently spikes in region eu-west-1. Ticket created CS-987; triage points to KV cache misses when cache cold.
   - Short term: enable aggressive prefix caching for the test nexus to confirm impact.
   - Long term: infra will investigate memory tuning across nodes. ETA: 3/24 (tentative).
   - Action: email product contact (Sonia) with workaround + ETA.

Other quick items / snippets:
- PO Template blurb to send to Procurement: "We can issue invoice net-30 upon receipt of signed SOW. For reserved capacity, please indicate the start date and desired commitment term (12/24 months)."
- One-line status update for handover email: "Picking up Lina's accounts this week — focusing on BrightBox QBR prep, AtlasFin renewal quote, and EduScale latency follow-up. Tracking all actions in CS tracker; will escalate blockers to you by EOD."

Known blockers / unknowns:
- Do we have updated perf numbers for v2-q8 model variant? (ask eng: @greg — slack thread #perf-kernel-ops)
- Does finance have a standard discount band for multi-year reserved capacity (>1yr)? (Luca to confirm)

Meeting cadences to schedule:
- 30m sync with BrightBox stakeholders: propose 3/26 10:00am PT — agenda: QBR dry run + demo VM walkthrough.
- Renewal prep with Finance: 3/19 1:00pm PT — confirm PO pipeline + any legal terms for reserved commitments.

Templates / canned replies (quick copy):
- Prod incident acknowledgement: "Thanks — I see the behavior, creating a ticket (CS-987) and looping infra. ETA for next update: 48 hours."
- Renewal nudge: "Hi Camille — following up on the renewal PO for 5/6 start. Can you confirm timeline or if you need a revised quote? Happy to hop on a 15m call."

Random notes to self:
- Keep the QBR deck light (<=12 slides), focus on 3 outcomes: reliability, cost, roadmap alignment.
- If AtlasFin asks for discount >15%, escalate to AM/RevOps.
- Capture all handover comms in the CS tracker row so Lina can pick up history.

Quick links I use:
- CS tracker (sheet): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/CS-tracker-id
- BrightBox perf ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-2123
- EduScale ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-987
- Slack: #cs-broad, #perf-kernel-ops

End-of-day stash (what to update before I leave):
- [ ] Record QBR slide stub in shared drive (folder: shared_drives/customer-success/qbr-drafts)
- [ ] Update AtlasFin renewal row + attach draft quote
- [ ] Ping infra for EduScale ETA and add note to ticket

-- Jordan
(leave short notes here so Lina has context when she returns)
summary: handover scratchpad for Jordan covering QBR, renewals, and support follow-ups
